data.title: Family — Beginner · Lesson 1
data.subject: family
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
It's a special day, everybody's here…
Family gathering, can't wait to cheer!

[Hook]
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños
Balloons flying… Globos volando
Let's celebrate… Vamos a celebrar
Family's here… La familia está aquí
We're all together, one, two, three…

[Verse]
Laughter's in the air, the cake's ready…
El pastel está listo, cantemos tan dulcemente.
The mother… La madre, she's smiling so bright.
The father… El padre, he's laughing all night.
El hermano, he's dancing, having such fun.
La hermana, she's singing, under the sun.

[Hook]
Happy birthday… Feliz cumpleaños
Balloons flying… Globos volando
Let's celebrate… Vamos a celebrar
Family's here… La familia está aquí
We're all together, one, two, three…

[Verse]
The son… El hijo, he's blowing out the light.
Candles flicker, wishes taking flight.
We're singing loud, voices in harmony.
Todos estamos juntos, es una sinfonía familiar.
The gifts are wrapped, sorpresas to explore.
